title: 第一卷 第11章 万众期待侯爷变脸第一卷 第12章 吞噬雷电快速进阶
lines: 西院后山，漫天落叶。
叶无尘这一剑，石破天惊，震慑全场。
谁能想到，一个三品灵根的平庸之子，居然如此不凡，两次战胜七品灵根的妖孽天才。
第二次还是一剑秒杀，毫无悬念！
此情此景，让侯府大部分人都看懵了。
老夫人更是眼前一黑，差点气晕当场，她看好的麒麟孙，居然被一个自己嫌弃的废物小子所碾压。
情感上实在难以接受！
姜牧野呆若木鸡地站在原地，脸色涨红，双拳紧握，心中羞愤而不甘！
他自幼就在赞誉声中长大，被所有人看好，侯府对自己亦是倾尽资源，寄予厚望。
所以，姜牧野的骨子里就是骄傲的，有着极强的自尊心。
但现在他居然连续两次输给叶无尘！
如此巨大打击之下，让姜牧野情绪有些癫狂，歇斯底里呐喊道：“为什么，为什么会这样，我乃七品灵根，天之骄子，凭什么会输给一个废物？”
周丽婷连忙上前安慰道：“牧儿，你先冷静一点，你还没输，你有七品灵根，将来成就必然远超叶无尘，他今天只是运气好而已，一时的胜败算不得什么！”
“哼，又说运气？”
叶蓉凤忍不住大笑道：“尘儿第一次取胜，或许是运气，但第二次还取胜，怎么又成运气了？大家都看得清清楚楚，尘儿可是一剑封喉，姜牧野连反抗之力都没有，在剑道上完完全全碾压式的胜利，周丽婷你还想狡辩不成？”
叶无尘也当即站出道：“我可以再给姜牧野一个比试剑法的机会，直到他服气为止！”
这句话，可是真正的诛心之言啊！
果不其然，姜牧野瞬间被激怒，神情狰狞道：“比就比！谁怕谁！”
“牧儿，不得胡闹！”
周丽婷连忙站出来阻止。
她何曾看不出叶无尘在剑法造诣上已远超姜牧野。
双方继续比试，结果必然是姜牧野惨败。
对于天才而言，连输两次已是巨大打击。
如果姜牧野第三次还败了，很可能会留下巨大的童年阴影，影响道心！
这东西可关乎他儿子未来的成长。
因此周丽婷当即拒绝道：“牧儿今天状态不佳，已经不宜比试，就算叶无尘赢了吧，毕竟剑法再厉害，没有灵根，将来成长上限也不高。”
叶蓉凤揶揄笑道：“什么叫算尘儿赢了，是尘儿本来就赢了，呵呵，你儿子的七品灵根若真有那么厉害，为何剑法比试却输了呢？”
周丽婷气得够呛，却无从辩驳。
今天这份屈辱，她只能受着！
而老夫人则神情尴尬，看向叶琉璃道：“琉璃啊，想不到你将尘儿这孩子教导得如此优秀，侯府会给你记功的！”
叶琉璃面无表情道：“老夫人，此言差矣，尘儿是我的孩子，我教导他是天经地义的事情，至于让侯府给我记功，我看没那个必要吧，第一，尘儿姓叶不姓姜，第二，尘儿这三年来，可未曾花过侯府任何一分钱，第三，老夫人您不是说了嘛，不允许对外说尘儿与候府存在任何关系！”
老夫人额头上冒出豆大的汗珠，脸色难看道：“呃，当年说是这么说，那不是一时气话嘛……咱们好歹是一家人啊！”
今天，叶无尘展现出了非凡的剑道天赋，很可能就是天生剑灵体！
一旦剑灵体之事坐实，叶无尘是板上钉钉会被侯府重点栽培的。
因此，老夫人自然开始试图想要修复与叶琉璃之间的关系。
姜元武乃一家之主，当场一锤定音道：“琉璃，我知道你心中有气，但关乎尘儿前程与未来之事，你还需以大局为重！尘儿是侯府的血脉，这是毋庸置疑的事情！”
“现在开始说尘儿是侯府血脉了？之前怎么就不管不问呢？”
叶琉璃只觉得可笑，不过她并未反驳什么，而是选择了沉默。
她受点委屈没什么。
但尘儿如果能得到候府的看重，自然是一桩好事。
“哼，现在开始来跪舔我了吗？可惜已经晚了！”
content_en:
The mountain behind the west courtyard is filled with fallen leaves.
Ye Wuchen's sword was shocking and shocked the entire audience.
Who would have thought that a mediocre son with a third-grade spiritual root could be so extraordinary, defeating an evil genius with a seventh-grade spiritual root twice.
The second time, he was killed instantly with one sword, without any suspense!
This situation made most of the people in the Hou Mansion bewildered.
The old lady's vision went dark, and she almost fainted on the spot. The Qilin Sun she was optimistic about was crushed by a good-for-nothing boy she despised.
It’s really hard to accept emotionally!
Jiang Muye stood there dumbfounded, his face flushed, his fists clenched, feeling ashamed, angry and unwilling to give up!
He grew up surrounded by praises since he was a child, and was favored by everyone. The Marquis also devoted all its resources to him and placed high hopes on him.
Therefore, Jiang Muye is proud at heart and has extremely strong self-esteem.
But now he actually lost to Ye Wuchen twice in a row!
Such a huge blow made Jiang Muye feel a little crazy, and he shouted hysterically: "Why, why is this happening? I am a seventh-grade spiritual root, the proud son of heaven, why should I lose to a loser?"
Zhou Liting hurriedly stepped forward to comfort her: "Mu'er, please calm down first. You haven't lost yet. You have seventh-grade spiritual roots, and your future achievements will definitely be far greater than Ye Wuchen's. He just had good luck today, and the temporary victory or defeat is nothing!"
"Huh, are you talking about luck again?"
Ye Rongfeng couldn't help laughing and said: "Chen'er's victory the first time may have been luck, but why did he win the second time? Everyone can see clearly that Chen'er sealed his throat with a sword, and Jiang Muye didn't even have the strength to resist. It was a complete crushing victory in the way of the sword. Zhou Liting, do you still want to quibble?"
Ye Wuchen also immediately stood up and said: "I can give Jiang Muye another chance to test his sword skills until he is convinced!"
This sentence is truly heart-wrenching!
As expected, Jiang Muye was instantly irritated and said with a ferocious expression: "Let's compete! Whoever is afraid of whom!"
"Mu'er, don't mess around!"
Zhou Liting quickly stood up to stop him.
How could she not see that Ye Wuchen had far surpassed Jiang Muye in swordsmanship?
The two sides continued to compete, and the result was bound to be a disastrous defeat for Jiang Muye.
For a genius, losing twice in a row is a huge blow.
If Jiang Muye loses for the third time, it is likely to leave a huge shadow of his childhood and affect his Taoist heart!
This thing is related to his son's future growth.
Therefore, Zhou Liting immediately refused and said: "Mu'er is not in good condition today and it is no longer suitable for the competition. Let's just assume that Ye Wuchen wins. After all, no matter how powerful the swordsmanship is, without spiritual roots, the upper limit of future growth will not be high."
Ye Rongfeng teased and said: "What do you mean Chen'er won? Chen'er won in the first place. Haha, if your son's seventh-grade spiritual root is really so powerful, why did he lose in the swordsmanship competition?"
"You!"
Zhou Liting was so angry that she couldn't argue.
She could only bear the humiliation today!
The old lady looked embarrassed and looked at Ye Liuli and said: "Liuli, I never thought you taught this child Chen'er so well, the Hou Mansion will record your merits!"
Ye Liuli said expressionlessly: "Old Madam, this is wrong. Chen'er is my child, and it is only natural for me to teach him. As for letting the Hou Mansion record my merits, I don't think it is necessary. First, Chen'er's surname is Ye, not Jiang. Second, Chen'er has never spent any money from the Hou Mansion in the past three years. Third, didn't you tell me, Old Madam, that Chen'er is not allowed to have any relationship with the Hou Mansion?"
Big beads of sweat appeared on the old lady's forehead, and she said with an ugly face: "Well, I said that back then, wasn't that just out of anger... We are a family after all!"
Today, Ye Wuchen showed extraordinary talent in swordsmanship, and he was probably born with a sword spirit!
Once the sword spirit body matter is confirmed, it is certain that Ye Wuchen will be the focus of cultivation by the Hou Mansion.
Therefore, the old lady naturally began to try to repair the relationship with Ye Liuli.
Jiang Yuanwu, the head of the family, said decisively on the spot: "Liu Li, I know you are angry, but when it comes to Chen'er's future, you still have to put the overall situation first! Chen'er is the blood of the Hou family, there is no doubt about it!"
"Now you are saying that Chen'er is of the Hou family's bloodline? Why didn't you just ignore it before?"
Ye Liuli only thought it was ridiculous, but she did not refute anything, but chose to remain silent.
It's okay for her to feel a little wronged.
But it would be a good thing if Chen'er could get the attention of the Marquis.
"Hmph, are you going to kneel and lick me now? It's a pity that it's too late!"
